decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for approval

The proposed two storey side and single storey rear extension, by means of its size, positioning, design and appearance, has due respect for the dwelling's original design and the character of the immediate locality and would not harm the living conditions of adjoining residents or the free flow and safety of traffic or the availability of on street parking.  The proposal therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and complies with the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the use of the house as a single-family residential dwelling.

Condition : 6 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northeastern or southwestern sidewalls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - The roof area of the rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.

Condition : 8 - The means of access would need to be widened to 3.6m in order to access the two parking spaces proposed to the front of the dwelling.  The works hereby permitted shall not begin until details of the modified means of access to the highway have been submitted to and approved by the Council.
description: Erection of first floor side extension to dwellinghouse
